sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, the Meta SDK, and Firebase Analytics.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Removes the eBay Live carousels of live-stream listings from the home tab, recommendations, search, vertical pages, item pages, and ads.
Opens listings at eBay's own page, without eBay Partner Network affiliate tags or click tracking.
